name: Gradaly v4.6.0
title: Gradaly v4.6.0
notes:
### 🌍 Dedicated Project Language (Independent of UI Language) & OpenRouter Python Sandbox
- **Dedicated Project Language (`v4.6.0`)**: Each project now carries its own explicit language (chosen at project creation and configurable at any time via the header language badge or *Project AI Settings*), completely independent of Gradaly's interface language. An instructor can work in a French UI while designing rubrics, running AI grading, generating individualized student feedback, and exporting annotated PDFs, Excel gradebooks, Moodle CSVs, QR slips, or Web Portals in English (or any of the 10 supported languages) — and vice versa. Removed the ambiguous `auto` prompt language mode, with automatic migration for existing projects.
- **OpenRouter Native Python Code Execution (`openrouter:shell`)**: Enabling *Python Code Execution (Calculations & Verification)* in Advanced Settings now works natively with OpenRouter models via `openrouter:shell` on `/api/v1/responses` (during grading, rubric design, and the 1-click sandbox test), alongside a dedicated computation status dot in the header (sky-blue when active & supported, red when disabled or unsupported).
- **Core Runtime & UI Refinements**: Upgraded Tauri runtime and plugins to `v2.12.7` and simplified the Settings text size selector to clean `A-` / `A+` controls.
